scripts.build: npm run build -w @matjari/shared && npm run build -w @matjari/api && npm run build -w @matjari/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @matjari/shared && npm run typecheck -w @matjari/shared && npm run typecheck -w @matjari/api && npm run typecheck -w @matjari/web
scripts.migration:run: npm run db:create -w @matjari/api && npm run migration:run -w @matjari/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @matjari/shared && npm run build -w @matjari/shared && npm run test -w @matjari/api
